Apple rarely introduces a new screen size for the iPhone, but the iPhone Ultra launching this fall will arrive with two screen formats and sizes that have never before appeared on an iPhone. Here's what you can expect.

The iPhone Ultra will introduce two all-new screen formats and sizes

The Apple iPhone lineup has, for the most part, offered similar screen size options over the years.

Aside from the occasional tweak, recent iPhones have largely come in two size categories: a 6.1- to 6.3-inch version, and a larger 6.7- to 6.9-inch version.

This year, however, the iPhone Ultra will bring two entirely new screen sizes that are unlike anything we've seen before.

Here are the rumored screen sizes of the iPhone Ultra:

  • Around a 5.3-inch outer screen
  • Around a 7.6-inch inner screen

Both options are noticeably different from recent iPhone screens.

The outer screen will be much smaller than what we're used to, while the inner screen will be larger than the iPhone 17 Pro Max.

The iPhone Ultra will be shorter than other modern iPhones, but wider at the same time. This could result in a fairly unique look and feel compared to past iPhones.

How iOS and apps will adapt to this entirely new screen format and size, we'll have to wait until September to find out.

That said, from the current iOS 27 betas, it looks like Apple is working to add landscape mode support for iPhone apps. Third-party apps will likely follow suit, taking full advantage of an inner screen that's actually larger than the iPad mini's display.

What do you think of the rumored design of the iPhone Ultra? Let us know in the comments.
